@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+# docs/decisions - one file per PR, gathered into RECOMMENDED.md at the cut
+
+Issue branches never edit `RECOMMENDED.md`. Every branch appending to the
+end of one shared file made each merge re-conflict every other open PR
+(user, 2026-11-08: "this is getting annoying"). Instead, a PR records its
+decisions in its own file here:
+
+    docs/decisions/<issue>-<slug>.md      e.g. docs/decisions/208-axis-point.md
+
+Use the same entry format as `RECOMMENDED.md`: a `## #N - <title>` heading,
+then **what was decided**, **why**, what was considered and dropped, and
+what it would cost to change later. One PR, one file. A review fix on the
+same PR edits that PR's file, never another PR's.
+
+At a minor or major cut, `scripts/collect-decisions.ps1` (or
+`scripts/collect-decisions.sh`) appends every file here, in issue-number
+order, to `RECOMMENDED.md` under a `## vX.Y.Z` heading, then deletes those
+files. This file, `README.md`, stays.

@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+# Gather docs/decisions/*.md into RECOMMENDED.md at a release cut (one file
+# per PR keeps issue branches from conflicting on RECOMMENDED.md).
+# Usage: scripts/collect-decisions.ps1 -Version 0.14.0
+param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Version)
+$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
+$dir = Join-Path $root 'docs/decisions'
+$out = Join-Path $root 'RECOMMENDED.md'
+$files = @(Get-ChildItem -Path $dir -Filter '*.md' | Where-Object { $_.Name -ne 'README.md' } |
+    Sort-Object { $n = 0; [void][int]::TryParse(($_.BaseName -split '-')[0], [ref]$n); $n }, Name)
+if ($files.Count -eq 0) { Write-Host 'no decision files to collect'; exit 0 }
+$text = "`n## v$Version - decisions gathered at the cut`n"
+foreach ($f in $files) { $text += "`n" + (Get-Content -Raw -Encoding utf8 $f.FullName).TrimEnd() + "`n" }
+Add-Content -Path $out -Value $text -Encoding utf8 -NoNewline
+foreach ($f in $files) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f.FullName }
+Write-Host ("collected {0} decision file(s) into RECOMMENDED.md" -f $files.Count)

@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Gather docs/decisions/*.md into RECOMMENDED.md at a release cut (one file
+# per PR keeps issue branches from conflicting on RECOMMENDED.md).
+# Usage: scripts/collect-decisions.sh 0.14.0
+set -euo pipefail
+version="${1:?usage: collect-decisions.sh <version>}"
+root="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
+dir="$root/docs/decisions"
+files=$(cd "$dir" && ls *.md 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^README.md$' | sort -t- -k1,1n -k2 | sed "s#^#$dir/#" || true)
+[ -z "$files" ] && { echo "no decision files to collect"; exit 0; }
+{ printf '\n## v%s - decisions gathered at the cut\n' "$version"
+  for f in $files; do printf '\n'; cat "$f"; printf '\n'; done; } >> "$root/RECOMMENDED.md"
+n=0; for f in $files; do rm -- "$f"; n=$((n+1)); done
+echo "collected $n decision file(s) into RECOMMENDED.md"
